mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(rl.invitee_id) FROM t_profiles p LEFT JOIN t_reward_ledger rl ON rl.invitee_id=p.id AND rl.event_type='first_order' WHERE p.id=#{uid} GROUP BY p.id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_profiles SET valid_invitee_count=#{count},invite_tier=#{tier} WHERE id=#{uid} AND (valid_invitee_count <> #{count} OR invite_tier <> #{tier})
mapper.select: SELECT invite_tier AS tier,valid_invitee_count AS valid_count,commission_mtd FROM t_profiles WHERE id=#{uid}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN currency='cny' THEN amount/100.0 ELSE 0 END),0) AS total_cny,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN currency='points' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS total_points FROM t_reward_ledger WHERE inviter_id=#{uid} AND status <> 'revoked'
